simple.meaning: מַהְפֶּכֶת (mahpeketh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a wrench , i.e. the stocks.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Chronicles 16:10. The surrounding context includes family line, priesthood, prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַהְפֶּכֶת (H4115) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַהְפֶּכֶת (mahpeketh) / H4115 is traced through 2 Chronicles 16:10, Jeremiah 20:2, Jeremiah 20:3, Jeremiah 29:26 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.

timeline.evidenceText: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.
Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh’s house.
On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “Yahweh has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.* “Magormissabib” means “surrounded by terror”

“Yahweh has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in Yahweh’s house, for every man who is crazy, and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.

definitions.full: H4115. mahpeketh מַהְמֶּ֫כֶת noun feminine stocks or similar instrument of punishment (compelling crooked posture, or distorting ), mentioned rather late; as punishment for Jeremiah ׳הַמּ בִּנְיָמִן בְּשֹׁעַר אֲשֶׁר Jer 20:2 ( ᵐ5 εἱς τὸν καταράκτην κ.τ.λ. ), compare ׳אֶלהַֿמּ 29:26 ( ᵐ5 εἰς τὸ ἀπόκλεισμα ; || ᵐ5 אֶלהַֿצִּינֹק, εἰς τὸν καταράκτην , but order of words perhaps reversed in ᵐ5 ); הַמַּהְמָּ֑כֶת 20:3 ; הַמַּהְמֶּכֶת בֵּית assigned also to Asa's time 2Chr 16:10 ( ᵐ5 εἰς φυλακήν ; ᵐ5 L εἰς οἶκον φυλακῆς ; compare Acts 16:24 , where εἰς τὴν ἐσωτέραν φυλακήν , + εἰς τὸ ξύλον ).
